title: Treat partial multi-entity application as a different treatment from the intended plan
scenario: A planned three-keyword bid reduction was only applied to two keywords. The third keyword remained unchanged. Aggregate campaign ACoS improved, and the request asks whether the planned change worked.

forbidden_behaviors: Label the intended three-keyword treatment fully applied.
Credit aggregate campaign improvement to the full intended treatment without resolving partial application.
Mark the plan Worked solely from aggregate campaign ACoS.
required_observations: Only two of the three intended entities changed according to readback.
The realized treatment differs materially from the intended treatment.
Aggregate campaign improvement cannot isolate the effect of the two applied keyword changes without entity-level outcome evidence.

rubric.requirement: Classify the change as Partial rather than Confirmed for the intended multi-entity plan.
Do not attribute aggregate campaign improvement to a treatment that was only partially applied.
Prefer manual review, hold, or directional interpretation until realized treatment and entity outcomes are reconciled.
